page_title: CHE 0-1 AST | Chelsea v Aston Villa 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Jarred Gillett is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+11' Flag up against Armando Broja (Chelsea). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90+10' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+5' Aston Villa fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+4' The referee shows the yellow card to Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).
90+2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90+1' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) sees a yellow card from Jarred Gillett after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90' 11 additional min. will be played.
90' Here is a change. Ollie Watkins is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
90' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jarred Gillett ignores the protests.
90' Boubacar Kamara will be replaced by Leander Dendoncker (Aston Villa).
87' It seemed like Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
84' The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner.

84' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Robert Sanchez sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post. The linesman makes the right call and Aston Villa will have a corner.
82' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
81' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Moussa Diaby is replaced by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
80' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Armando Broja (Chelsea) is replacing Moises Caicedo.
76' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) tested Emiliano Martinez with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved. Chelsea force their opponents to concede a corner.
75' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) replacing John McGinn.
75' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo will be replaced by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa).
75' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
73' 0 - 1 It’s a GOAL! It looked impossible to score from that angle, but Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) somehow finds the net with a cheeky shot past the keeper from close in.
73' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

71' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
68' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Enzo Fernandez will be replaced by Cole Palmer (Chelsea).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chimuanya Ugochukwu (Chelsea) replaces Nicolas Jackson.
65' Aston Villa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Aston Villa will take a corner.
65' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
61' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
61' The substitution is prepared. Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mykhailo Mudryk.
60' John McGinn (Aston Villa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Aston Villa get a corner.
58' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Malo Gusto (Chelsea) has to leave the pitch!
56' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Malo Gusto (Chelsea)! Let's see what he decides.
56' The foul by Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jarred Gillett.
53' The game is interrupted as Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) is flagged offside.
53' A quickly taken corner by Aston Villa.
50' The referee Jarred Gillett awards Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) a yellow card.
48' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
47' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
47' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Lucas Digne (Aston Villa), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
44' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Axel Disasi (Chelsea) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
44' The corner is swung in but Chelsea can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
44' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Chelsea earn a corner.
42' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) is flagged for offside.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.
41' A pass by Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
40' The resulting set piece from Aston Villa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Aston Villa will take a corner kick.
39' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) hammers the ball towards the roof of the net, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Robert Sanchez, who denies him with a terrific save. Aston Villa have a corner.
39' John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
37' Aston Villa have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.

35' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
35' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
34' Aston Villa quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
32' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
28' A pass from Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) is intercepted by Robert Sanchez and the move breaks down.
25' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) inside the box. The linesman points to the corner flag, Chelsea are going to take it.
22' A cross from Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
21' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
20' Aston Villa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

20' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the roof of the net. It would have probably ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Robert Sanchez and his brilliant save. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
19' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

19' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
18' The linesman raises his flag. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is adjudged offside.
13' A pass from Levi Colwill (Chelsea) is intercepted by Emiliano Martinez and the move breaks down.
8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Chelsea comes to nothing.
8' The ball is cleared after Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
7' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Matty Cash (Aston Villa), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
5' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez was alert and made a comfortable save.
4' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
2' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
1' The match has just started.
Chelsea will kick the game off.
Jarred Gillett will referee today's match.
